scope: Explicit child-level audit routes only. Missing records are unassigned; parent coverage is never inherited.

states.dedicated: A field-centered audit directly addresses the named child classification.
states.adjacent: A durable audit touches the child classification but is not centered on it.

assignments.rationale: A field-centred comparative-physiology audit directly examines distributed supply, exchange, organ-system feedback, synchrony, and structural adaptation in animal physiology.
assignments.scopeGap: Animal biochemistry, molecular physiology, most taxa, reproductive physiology, ecological physiology, and in-vivo validation remain outside this audit.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which mechanisms survive cross-species and in-vivo tests after morphology, environment, developmental state, and whole-organism energy are measured?

assignments.rationale: The audit is explicitly comparative and uses bounded cross-system examples to derive falsifiable transport, control, accounting, and adaptation boundaries.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit is not a census of comparative physiology and does not cover ecological acclimation, reproductive systems, locomotor performance, sensory physiology, or most clades.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which claimed system boundaries reproduce across phylogenetically distant organisms under matched tasks, measurements, and energetic accounting?

assignments.rationale: System-level animal supply, renal, pulmonary, coupled-feedback, and remodelling examples are used, but the audit is centred on comparative transferable boundaries rather than a complete animal-systems programme.
assignments.scopeGap: Organ-system breadth, endocrine integration, digestion, reproduction, exercise, thermoregulation, and taxon-specific validation remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: How do the typed supply, feedback, and adaptation records interact across complete animal organ systems rather than isolated synthetic tracks?

assignments.rationale: The audit uses organ- and whole-system regulation, delayed feedback, prediction, regional matching, synchrony, and adaptation, while excluding clinical human physiology.
assignments.scopeGap: Human systems validation, disease, clinical endpoints, intervention pathways, and most interacting organ axes remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which multi-organ control and reserve interactions remain identifiable under causal interventions and complete material and energy ledgers?

assignments.rationale: The comparative audit covers animal transport and regulation in C-1488--C-1496; the plant audit independently covers acclimation, long-distance signalling, hydraulics, and resource allocation in C-1518--C-1525.
assignments.scopeGap: These bounded animal and plant slices do not exhaust cellular, microbial, ecological, pathological, reproductive, or human physiology.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which physiological mechanisms reproduce across kingdoms under matched perturbations, complete resource ledgers, and explicit transfer tests?

assignments.rationale: The audit directly treats bearings, seals, sliding pairs, lubrication choices, texture, coatings, contact-interface design, and mission-level qualification as machine-element and product-design problems.
assignments.scopeGap: The synthetic contracts do not qualify a physical bearing, seal, coating, lubricant, manufacturing process, product architecture, or service environment.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which interface-state and lifecycle boundaries remain valid in manufactured machine elements under measured loads, temperatures, contaminants, maintenance schedules, and failure consequences?

assignments.rationale: The rough-contact, lubricated-contact, wear-regime, and rate/state protocols use contact, compliance, dynamics, and stability models, but the audit is centred on tribological interfaces rather than mechanics as a field.
assignments.scopeGap: Continuum contact mechanics, fracture, multibody dynamics, elastohydrodynamic solvers, numerical convergence studies, and physical parameter identification remain outside the bounded CPU protocols.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do the proposed regime and stability gates survive higher-fidelity contact and dynamical models with independently identified parameters and controlled numerical error?

assignments.rationale: Surface texture, third-body circulation, tribofilm formation, adaptive coatings, and transfer perturbations touch coating and surface engineering while remaining parts of a broader tribology audit.
assignments.scopeGap: Deposition routes, surface chemistry, adhesion, residual stress, metrology uncertainty, manufacturing variability, coating qualification, and physical wear testing are not covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which texture and adaptive-surface effects reproduce after fabrication variability, surface metrology, chemistry, adhesion, and long-duration physical wear are included?

assignments.rationale: The field-centred audit directly covers friction, lubrication, wear, stick--slip, third-body behaviour, texture, adaptive/self-lubricating interfaces, and lifecycle-normalized tribological selection.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit freezes synthetic falsification contracts only; it does not report results or establish physical-material, component, or field performance.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which claim boundaries survive preregistered physical tribometer and component tests with full force, heat, wear, debris, service, maintenance, and lifecycle ledgers?

assignments.rationale: Every protocol uses explicit synthetic mechanical generators, state equations, solver or update rules, and model-qualification comparisons, but numerical modelling is supporting rather than the audit centre.
assignments.scopeGap: Mesh, discretization, solver-order, stiffness, convergence, identifiability, surrogate-error, and model-form uncertainty studies remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: How sensitive are the nine decisions to solver choice, model form, discretization, identified parameters, and propagated numerical uncertainty?

assignments.rationale: The audit is explicitly centred on tribology and supplies independent primary sources, claim boundaries, and nine reciprocal CPU-only falsification contracts.
assignments.scopeGap: One synthetic audit does not exhaust tribology and leaves physical contact, materials, chemistry, manufacturing, instrumentation, scale transfer, and in-service qualification open.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which additional tribological mechanisms add non-duplicative, testable boundaries beyond the present state, regime, mediator, adaptation, and lifecycle contracts?

assignments.rationale: C-1499 and TAI-T03 provide a lubrication-specific source and test boundary for operating-regime identification and transition handling rather than inheriting coverage from tribology.
assignments.scopeGap: Lubricant chemistry, rheology, additives, contamination, starvation, thermal degradation, elastohydrodynamic validation, supply systems, and physical film measurement remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do regime-aware decisions remain beneficial under measured lubricant properties, thermal and contamination histories, starvation, mixed lubrication, and independently observed film thickness?

assignments.rationale: All ten residues directly examine developmental specification, regeneration, pattern control, morphogenesis, or maturation boundaries.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit is mechanistic and synthetic; organismal breadth, evolutionary origin, and in-vivo validation remain open.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which developmental contracts survive lineage-resolved perturbation across organisms and scales?

assignments.rationale: These claims use force, geometry, transport, and physical constraint as developmental state variables.
assignments.scopeGap: No general biophysical theory, material calibration, or complete multiscale mechanics survey is supplied.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do measured forces and transport fields causally improve prediction beyond molecular state alone?

assignments.rationale: Cell-state transitions, interactions, mechanics, and tissue organisation support these four bounded residues.
assignments.scopeGap: Cellular metabolism, organelles, trafficking, division control, and broad cell-type coverage are not audited.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which cell-level variables remain necessary under direct intervention and lineage tracking?

assignments.rationale: Competence and structural consolidation touch gene-regulatory state without constituting a genetics audit.
assignments.scopeGap: No genome-wide association, comparative genomics, variant analysis, or functional-genomics programme is covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which regulatory variables are causal rather than correlated markers of competence and consolidation?

assignments.rationale: The claims formalise positional inference, collective signalling, multiscale morphology, and staged maturation as testable systems models.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit does not survey theoretical biology, bioinformatics pipelines, omics integration, or inference methodology broadly.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which model components are identifiable and predictive under held-out geometries and perturbations?

assignments.rationale: The complete audit is centred on animal developmental and regenerative mechanisms with ten reciprocal protocols.
assignments.scopeGap: Reproduction, whole-life development, most phyla, and organism-level validation remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which mechanisms generalise across animal lineages without erasing lineage-specific constraints?

assignments.rationale: C-1507 tests controlled state transition and regeneration competence at the cell-population level.
assignments.scopeGap: Proliferation, apoptosis, senescence, and death programmes are not generally covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Does competence predict regeneration after growth and survival effects are independently controlled?

assignments.rationale: Collective coordination, adhesion or matrix context, and mechanical coupling are explicit in these claims.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit does not cover the full interaction repertoire, matrix biology, or cell-wall biology.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which interaction channels are necessary when adhesion, matrix, and mechanics are perturbed separately?

assignments.rationale: The Wnt/β-catenin interface and EGF/HGF receptor-abundance memory claims directly test how membrane-proximal state and internal readout support finite-range relative sensing.
assignments.scopeGap: Two signalling examples do not cover receptor families, membrane transport, trafficking, lipid biology, electrophysiology, or tissue diversity.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which receptor and membrane states are causally necessary for relative sensing after alternative intracellular reference mechanisms are controlled?

assignments.rationale: The earlier audits cover positional, collective, hydraulic and plant-stress signals; C-1541--C-1548 directly compare relative, absolute and difference statistics across named bacterial, mammalian, amoebal and plant signalling interfaces.
assignments.scopeGap: The routed claims sample bounded pathways and do not survey receptor families, second messengers, post-translational networks, tissues, disease states, or all taxa.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which signal statistic and reference mechanism remain causal when interface, stimulus history, saturation and downstream target are varied independently?

assignments.rationale: The earlier claims require system-level positional inference and maturation control; C-1540--C-1549 directly formulate input--output symmetry, causal circuit alternatives, interface qualification and observation-dependent identifiability.
assignments.scopeGap: The audits do not provide field-wide systems biology, multi-omics integration, broad network reconstruction, or exhaustive organism and pathway coverage.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which scale symmetries survive causal interventions and hostile protocols while retaining absolute variables needed for downstream control?

assignments.rationale: These claims directly analyze whole-trajectory input symmetry, alternative network motifs, equivariance and observation-dependent structural identifiability.
assignments.scopeGap: Network inference, topology statistics, multi-omics integration, stochastic network reconstruction and broad dynamical-network analysis remain outside the fixture.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which interventions distinguish network mechanisms that are observationally equivalent under step inputs and one output map?

assignments.rationale: Developmental competence and consolidation invoke regulatory inheritance and commitment boundaries.
assignments.scopeGap: Sex determination, variant effects, genomic mapping, and comparative developmental genetics are unaddressed.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which genetic perturbations shift competence or consolidation without confounding viability?

assignments.rationale: Competence and regenerative state transitions have regenerative-medicine relevance, but the audit remains basic mechanism research.
assignments.scopeGap: No therapy, clinical model, safety case, manufacturing pathway, or patient endpoint is evaluated.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which bounded mechanisms reproduce in preclinical regeneration models under safety and delivery constraints?

assignments.rationale: C-1511 and C-1512 explicitly test force-sensitive organisation and morphogenetic mechanics.
assignments.scopeGap: Material characterisation, constitutive modelling, measurement uncertainty, and physical tissue validation remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do force interventions alter morphology as predicted after geometry and biochemical state are matched?

assignments.rationale: The developmental audit supports C-1506--C-1515 in animal mechanisms; the plant audit independently supports developmental plasticity, memory, growth, and integration in C-1516--C-1519, C-1522, and C-1523.
assignments.scopeGap: The two bounded audits do not cover all kingdoms, life stages, evo-devo, reproduction, or field development.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which control principles transfer across animal and plant development under homologous perturbation and resource accounting?

assignments.rationale: The selected claims depend on cell state, cell interaction, and force-coupled tissue organisation.
assignments.scopeGap: Most core cell-biology processes and cell types remain unaudited.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which cell-state measurements add causal explanatory power under matched tissue context?

assignments.rationale: Developmental claims C-1511, C-1512, and C-1514 use mechanics and scale coupling; plant claims C-1521, C-1522, C-1524, and C-1525 use electrical, hydraulic, transport, and allocation constraints.
assignments.scopeGap: Neither audit supplies general biophysical coverage or complete physical parameter identification.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which measured physical state variables remain predictive under hostile transfer and matched biochemical information?

assignments.rationale: Developmental competence and consolidation touch genetic regulation in C-1506 and C-1513; plant plasticity, inherited or somatic memory, priming, and growth integration touch it in C-1516--C-1518 and C-1523.
assignments.scopeGap: Genome-wide, population, quantitative, comparative, and molecular-genetic depth remain outside both audits.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which genetic or epigenetic interventions causally separate retained state from current environment and resource reserve?

assignments.rationale: Positional information, collective pattern correction, and staged maturation intersect embryological mechanisms.
assignments.scopeGap: Embryogenesis, germ layers, extraembryonic tissues, implantation, and comparative embryos are not systematically covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do the three contracts reproduce in embryo-scale systems across developmental windows?

assignments.rationale: These claims explicitly connect form, mechanical constraint, and multiscale morphological organisation.
assignments.scopeGap: Descriptive morphology, comparative anatomy, morphometrics, and natural-form diversity remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which morphology descriptors predict function after scale, material, and developmental history are controlled?

assignments.rationale: These eight residues directly test plant acclimation, systemic signalling, hydraulics, distributed integration, growth control, and allocation.
assignments.scopeGap: Photosynthesis, respiration, mineral nutrition, reproduction, whole-field ecophysiology, and most taxa remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which plant physiological contracts survive whole-plant perturbation under measured carbon, water, ion, and energy budgets?

assignments.rationale: The selected residues centre plant developmental plasticity, retained state, priming, growth response, distributed coordination, and architecture.
assignments.scopeGap: Cell-cycle control, organogenesis breadth, embryogenesis, reproduction, and most developmental stages are not covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which retained and distributed states causally alter plant development under matched current conditions?

assignments.rationale: Memory, priming, electrical or chemical waves, source--sink transport, and resource allocation invoke plant biochemical and biophysical mechanisms.
assignments.scopeGap: Molecular pathways, metabolomics, membrane biophysics, protein chemistry, and complete energetics are not surveyed.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which chemical and physical mediators remain necessary after matched state, communication, and resource controls?

assignments.rationale: Plasticity, stress memory, priming, and integrated growth depend partly on genetic or genomic regulatory state.
assignments.scopeGap: No breeding, population genomics, association mapping, comparative genomics, or genome-wide validation is included.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which regulatory variants or perturbations separate inherited capacity from acquired state and resource history?

assignments.rationale: All ten claims concern plant mechanisms, while the audit is centred on transferable plasticity and signalling rather than botany as a whole.
assignments.scopeGap: Taxonomy, diversity, anatomy, systematics, palaeobotany, floristics, and most plant lineages remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which mechanisms are conserved or divergent across phylogenetically distant plant lineages?

assignments.rationale: Priming, propagating systemic signals, hydraulic integration, source--sink communication, and allocation feedback explicitly use intercellular signalling.
assignments.scopeGap: Receptors, second messengers, pathway crosstalk, subcellular localisation, and broad signalling chemistry remain unexamined.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which signalling channels add causal information after transmission delay, reserve, and transport capacity are controlled?

assignments.rationale: Plastic developmental memory and stress priming may use chromatin or epigenetic retention, but the claims require direct retained-state tests rather than assuming mechanism.
assignments.scopeGap: Chromatin marks, causal editing, meiotic transmission, cell-type resolution, and multigenerational stability remain open.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do causal epigenetic interventions predict memory after current environment and physiological reserve are matched?

assignments.rationale: C-1542 directly uses E. coli FRET and microfluidic chemotaxis evidence to bound relative sensing and behavior within finite ligand regimes.
assignments.scopeGap: One chemotaxis system does not cover bacterial physiology, diversity, ecology, pathogenesis, metabolism, genetics, communities, or other sensory pathways.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which bacterial taxa and receptor architectures retain response rescaling after ligand identity, growth state, transport and ecological context change?

assignments.rationale: These six residues directly address plant developmental plasticity, retained stress state, priming, growth response, coordination, and architecture.
assignments.scopeGap: Reproduction and most developmental processes, organs, stages, and taxa remain outside the bounded audit.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which developmental effects persist across plant stages and lineages under causal state erasure?

assignments.rationale: The earlier claims cover plant acclimation, signalling, hydraulics, growth, transport and allocation; C-1547 adds an approximate, finite-regime chlorophyll-fluorescence response to relative light steps.
assignments.scopeGap: The route excludes large parts of metabolism, nutrition, reproduction, field ecology and taxonomic diversity; C-1547 is one Arabidopsis assay and does not establish whole-plant light control.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which relative and absolute light-response components reproduce in intact plants across acclimation, genotype and field histories with complete water, carbon, damage and energy accounting?

assignments.rationale: These claims explicitly distinguish retained plastic or primed state from current input, with epigenetics as one bounded candidate substrate.
assignments.scopeGap: No genome-scale methylation, histone, chromatin, inheritance, or causal-editing programme is supplied.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which epigenetic marks are causal, stable, and functionally predictive rather than exposure correlates?

assignments.rationale: Priming, growth response, systemic chemical signalling, source--sink exchange, and allocation have biochemical mediators and costs.
assignments.scopeGap: Pathway chemistry, metabolites, enzymes, proteomics, and biochemical flux validation are not covered comprehensively.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which biochemical fluxes explain gains after communication and construction costs are included?

assignments.rationale: These nine claims touch cellular state, molecular memory, cell-to-cell propagation, hydraulic coupling, growth control, and transport regulation.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit is not a comprehensive plant cell or molecular biology survey and lacks most organelles and pathways.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which cell and molecular measurements add out-of-distribution prediction beyond whole-plant state and resource ledgers?

assignments.rationale: This terminal DFG subject is the preserved hierarchy's finest available route for the audit's projection, asymptotic, numerical multiscale, and equation-free mathematics.
assignments.scopeGap: The four residues cover narrow applied constructions, not pure mathematics or mathematics as a whole.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which error, stability, and cost guarantees survive nonlinear, stochastic, and high-dimensional hostile-transfer cases?

assignments.rationale: C-1527 directly tests slow--fast asymptotic reduction under normal-hyperbolicity and fold boundaries.
assignments.scopeGap: Other asymptotic limits, approximation theory, singular perturbations, and rigorous rates are not surveyed.
assignments.nextQuestion: How sharply do spectral margin and time-scale separation predict reduction error near loss of normal hyperbolicity?

assignments.rationale: Projected memory, slow-manifold reduction, and lift--evolve--restrict are directly formulated as applied dynamical-system problems.
assignments.scopeGap: Control, bifurcation breadth, stochastic dynamics, chaos, and application-domain diversity remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which reduced dynamics remain stable and predictive under memory, folds, lifting bias, and distribution shift?

assignments.rationale: C-1528 and C-1529 directly compare numerical multiscale and equation-free estimators with explicit error and cost ledgers.
assignments.scopeGap: Discretisation families, conditioning, floating-point effects, adaptive meshes, and general convergence analysis remain open.
assignments.nextQuestion: When do complete micro-query and lifting costs outweigh accuracy-preserving numerical reduction?

assignments.rationale: C-1528 fixes a differential-equation micro-query, compression, reconstruction, error, and work contract for heterogeneous multiscale computation.
assignments.scopeGap: Only a bounded elliptic-style protocol is specified; other equations, solvers, and boundary conditions are not covered.
assignments.nextQuestion: Does the local micro-query contract retain savings and accuracy across coefficient contrast, scale separation, and boundaries?

assignments.rationale: The finite-dimensional geometric singular-perturbation fixture uses ordinary differential equations and dynamical systems but does not survey the field.
assignments.scopeGap: Difference equations, broad ODE theory, global dynamics, bifurcations, and applications beyond the fixture remain unaddressed.
assignments.nextQuestion: How does the reduction boundary change for higher-dimensional, non-autonomous, or weakly stochastic ODE systems?

assignments.rationale: All four claims directly convert projection, asymptotic, multiscale, and coarse-timestepper theory into falsifiable applied-mathematical contracts.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit covers four reduction families, not applied mathematics broadly or any application field by inheritance.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which reduction family gives the best validated error--cost tradeoff under matched information and construction budgets?

assignments.rationale: The HMM and equation-free claims directly define numerical estimators, baselines, errors, costs, and invalidity gates.
assignments.scopeGap: General numerical analysis, solver theory, stability classes, and finite-precision analysis are outside the bounded protocols.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which estimator remains superior after all microsteps, lifting, restriction, variance, and failure recovery are charged?

assignments.rationale: Three claims directly study reduced evolution with memory, invariant slow structure, or coarse time stepping.
assignments.scopeGap: Field-wide dynamical-systems coverage, chaos, control, networks, stochasticity, and most bifurcations are absent.
assignments.nextQuestion: Can closure diagnostics predict when reduced evolution fails before downstream task error becomes unacceptable?

assignments.rationale: All four residues use differential-equation systems or operators, but equations are vehicles for reduction rather than the audit's complete subject.
assignments.scopeGap: Existence, uniqueness, regularity, boundary theory, broad equation classes, and analytical solution methods remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which equation properties determine memory length, manifold validity, local-query error, and closure failure?

assignments.rationale: The elliptic heterogeneous-multiscale protocol in C-1528 is a bounded partial-differential-equation application.
assignments.scopeGap: Parabolic, hyperbolic, nonlinear, stochastic, moving-boundary, and coupled PDEs are not audited.
assignments.nextQuestion: Does the HMM contract remain valid beyond the elliptic case under explicit boundary and regularity stress?

assignments.rationale: The audit directly treats physical chemistry at charged interfaces through nonequilibrium kinetics, finite transport, immittance validity, inverse time distributions, and depletion-driven field change.
assignments.scopeGap: Molecular spectroscopy, photochemistry, colloids, broad biophysical chemistry, molecular dynamics, statistical mechanics, and real-apparatus breadth remain unreviewed.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which interface and transport conclusions survive chemistry, geometry, temperature, frequency-band, and observation-operator transfer?

assignments.rationale: Phase, passivation, ramified growth, insertion hysteresis, parameter identification, and degradation touch solid-state and surface characterization, but the audit is centered on electrochemical mechanism contracts.
assignments.scopeGap: General solid-state synthesis, diffraction and microscopy, adsorption, surface reconstruction, catalysis, corrosion, and material-characterization practice remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do the inferred phase, interface, and degradation states remain identifiable under independent structural and surface measurements?

assignments.rationale: All ten claims are formulated from electrochemical interface, transport, impedance, phase, passivation, deposition, identifiability, hysteresis, or ageing sources.
assignments.scopeGap: Corrosion, electrocatalysis breadth, bioelectrochemistry, electroanalysis, industrial electrolysis, and experimental apparatus qualification remain incomplete.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which bounded mechanisms survive independent cells, chemistries, operators, and measurement systems after full uncertainty and lifecycle cost are charged?

assignments.rationale: Several claims use storage-material phase, interphase, deposition, state estimation, hysteresis, and lifetime optimization, without surveying storage and conversion engineering as a field.
assignments.scopeGap: Cell and pack design, thermal management, manufacturing, safety, power electronics, fuel cells, supercapacitors, system integration, recycling, and qualification remain outside scope.
assignments.nextQuestion: Do the mechanisms improve an accepted storage service after cell, pack, control, safety, maintenance, and end-of-life burdens are included?

assignments.rationale: The field-gap audit is explicitly centered on electrochemical mechanisms, measurements, inverse problems, state, and degradation.
assignments.scopeGap: The audit samples ten mechanisms and does not imply complete electrochemistry coverage or inherit coverage to every narrower concept.
assignments.nextQuestion: Which interface, transport, inverse, and lifetime mechanisms remain useful after hostile regime and apparatus transfer?

assignments.rationale: Battery phase, interphase, deposition, identifiability, hysteresis, and ageing provide direct examples, while the audit's target is transferable mechanism discipline rather than battery engineering.
